7.9.5.7 Read Emission-Related Diagnostic Trouble Codes with Permanent Sta-
tus
OBD regulations require to store DTCs in a permanent memory that is not cleared with
a ClearDTC command or on power fail. DTCs entered in the permanent memory are
removed under special conditions. These special conditions are defined by the OBD
regulations.
An OBD related DTC entering the permanent fault memory with illuminating the MIL
and removed with deactivating the MIL.
[SWS_Dem_00300]
Storing permanent DTCs ⌈The Dem shall store Permanent
DTCs according to the regulation as defined by [21] within the DTCOrigin DEM_DTC_
ORIGIN_PERMANENT_MEMORY.⌋
For details refer to OBD relevant DTCs in chapter 7.4.1.
[SWS_Dem_00301] Reporting stored permanent DTCs ⌈On a set DTC filter via
Dem_SetDTCFilter and DTCOrigin = DEM_DTC_ORIGIN_PERMANENT_MEMORY,
the Dem shall report in Dem_GetNextFilteredDTC the stored permanent DTCs.⌋
PFC Cycle
A SWC can use the Dem to get the state of the PFC cycle. The DemOBDPFCCycleRef
defines the cycle used for the PFC cycle, it’s state can be polled by the application via
Dem_GetCycleQualified. The SWC may use this information on the MIL Master
Ecu to forward it as "Minimum trip conditions satisfied" via the vehicle network to the
primary ECUs.
In a primary ECU the interface Dem_GetCycleQualified can be used to get in-
formed that the current OBD driving cycle has met the criteria for the PFC cycle by a
SWC.
